card.name: "its" after hypersensitivity to a drug
card.fires_on: The word "its" (rarely a comma) right after a drug name in contraindication lists about hypersensitivity, just before "inactive ingredients", "excipients" or "constituents".

modes.label: its before ingredients
modes.description: "its" follows a drug name or "the product and/or" in a hypersensitivity contraindication, leading into the drug's components.
modes.example: known hypersensitivity to nabumetone or<< its>> excipients

modes.label: comma in ingredient list
modes.description: A comma after "its ingredients" in the same kind of hypersensitivity list, leading into other related drugs.
modes.example: known hypersensitivity to felbamate oral suspension, its ingredients<<,>> or known sensitivity to other carbamates

card.plain: It marks the spot in a contraindication where the text says allergic to the drug or its ingredients, so the next words will be about the drug's components.
